competences.description: Attacks the enemy and provokes the target for 1 turn with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The target is forced to attack the Monster that is provoked.

competences.description: Removes 1 harmful effect of all allies and grants Endure on the ally target for 2 turns. When used on a dead ally, the target is revived with 50% HP, but adds 2 turns of cooldown time.

effets.description: The target's HP will not drop below 1 even when attacked.
Puts the target's skill on cool down.
effets.note: Increases self turn cooltime by 2 turns each revive.

competences.description: Places a {tomb_dark} on the spot of an ally when an ally dies. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: When Cherished Tombstone is on the ally side, increases the Attack Speed of all allies by 50%, and recovers the HP of all allies by 10% at the start of your turn. Cherished Tombstone will disappear if the ally at the spot is revived or if the caster dies.
